newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice end mixed, hedges limit new crop months.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice end mixed, hedges limit new crop months.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended mixed in extremely light volume Tuesday, with modest hedge pressure noted in September and November contracts, floor traders said.
"It was another very slow day," said one pit trader. "We don't even see much business show up until noon because of the meeting."
Most in the trade with ties to the cash market are attending a meeting of the Rice Millers Association in San Diego this week.
That meeting has severely curtailed interest in rice futures, traders said.
Rice ended one cent lower to one cent per cwt higher with July down up one at $11.46.
Volume was estimated by CBOT at 200 lots, compared with Monday's actual volume of 134 on Monday.
